split_execution: test-all runs normal and challenge splits concurrently with separate memory, outputs, runtime caches and temporary paths. Tasks within each split remain sequential. Wait for both splits; either failure fails the invocation. Recovery skips completed splits.
consolidation_prompt_policy: Base consolidation defers candidates whose complete system and user messages exceed 900000 UTF-8 bytes. Record byte counts and the reason in updates.json without a consolidation chat call or memory write. Preserve full evidence and continue subsequent candidates; the byte budget is not a token estimate.
parent_source: Thin variant of experiment/appworld/retrieval.py --preset efficiency_1 and retrieval.variant.json; shares the unchanged src/memory_retrieval/presets/efficiency_1.json preset. Reuses src/base/pipeline.py and the existing AppWorld launcher, executor, worker and completed-task recovery. Each run preserves actual MetaWeft and sibling working-source snapshots, including uncommitted changes, preset JSON, prompts and descriptors. No copied retrieval implementation or runtime exploration imports.
hypothesis: Test whether native 3072-dimensional text-embedding-3-large vectors improve ordered AppWorld task outcomes relative to the matched 1024-dimensional efficiency_1 parent.
intended_differences: Only embedding dimensions change from 1024 to 3072. Preserve efficiency_1 search/ranking and its provider policy, final retrieval k=5, base adaptation, 40-step execution, reflection, consolidation, feedback access and fresh-memory lifecycle. A separate setting/output/recovery family prevents mixing vector sizes.
memory_structure: Base's flat per-stream Elasticsearch records with stable IDs, when_to_use, content, source evidence references and combined 3072-dimensional text-embedding-3-large vectors. Preserve complete records, vectors and mapping in checkpoints.
retrieval: Unchanged efficiency_1 identity-query combined-vector preset: HNSW depth 20, 40 ANN candidates, RRF constant 20 and fused limit 20, nonthinking qwen3.8-flash listwise ranking to 20, and top five to adaptation. Five retrieval retries with 60-second delays. Empty memory avoids paid retrieval calls; listwise ranking bypasses banks below 20. Consolidation retains its separate five-neighbor search.
adaptation: Base's single task-conditioned adaptation pass over retrieved records, including usable degraded ranking fallbacks. No within-task retrieval refresh or additional adaptation loop.
execution_context: Base executor prompt and ReAct interaction mechanics; qwen3.8-flash, temperature 0.9, model seed 0, thinking disabled, 40 interactions, one trial and AppWorld random seed 100. Adapted guidance enters the initial context once. Preserve shared official loading, evaluation and task-owned canonical logging.
evidence_update: Base reflection on task specification, full execution trace and scalar reward proposes at most three candidates. Sequential consolidation adds, skips, revises or defers using allowed supporting evidence. Complete confirmed updates and a verified memory checkpoint before advancing; no automatic deletion or capacity-driven eviction.
feedback_access: Ranking sees task instruction and candidate when_to_use/content under local indices; source evidence and evaluation labels are excluded. Adaptation sees the task and retrieved records. Reflection/consolidation may use preserved task specifications, execution traces and official scalar rewards. Private solutions and evaluator assertions remain evaluation-only.
memory_lifetime: Empty memory independently per fresh run and test split; ordered tasks share completed updates. Recovery restores the last committed memory into a new isolated index using saved source and settings. Writable benchmark state remains isolated; only the completed LLM response store is shared. no_cache is the default. No warm start, training, task parallelism or within-task resume.
failure_reporting: Preserve explicit degraded retrieval fallbacks and stage outcomes. Exhausted provider/cache calls, canonical logging failures and unavailable required checkpoints are fatal. Preserve incomplete-task evidence without restoring its partial memory updates. Account for all stages, retries and inherited attempts; separate cache hits and unknown usage/cost.
recovery_protocol: Existing recovery format 1 and immutable identity checks. efficiency_1_emb3072 has its own setting/output family; automatic and explicit recovery cannot mix it with efficiency_1. Preserve saved 3072-dimensional vectors, mapping, source and settings. The composed run descriptor embeds the unchanged efficiency_1 retrieval_meta and preset descriptor as provenance.
note: Automatic efficiency_1 retrieval description followed by emb3072; optional user annotation follows.
